CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".studio_draft_revisions (
    draft_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES "honua".studio_package_drafts(draft_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    generation BIGINT NOT NULL,
    envelope JSONB NOT NULL,
    updated_by TEXT,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (draft_id, generation)
)

-- Capture OLD in the writer's transaction, including writers running an older server image.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "honua".archive_studio_draft_revision()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS '
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO "honua".studio_draft_revisions
        (draft_id, generation, envelope, updated_by, updated_at)
    VALUES (OLD.draft_id, OLD.generation, OLD.envelope, OLD.updated_by, OLD.updated_at);
    RETURN NEW;
END;
'

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER trg_archive_studio_draft_revision
AFTER UPDATE ON "honua".studio_package_drafts
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (OLD.generation IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.generation)
EXECUTE FUNCTION "honua".archive_studio_draft_revision()
